entries.observation_text: Great session. 15 weeks in — visible improvements in posture and confidence.
Hip still bothering her but manageable. Leg press feels strong at 50kg.

Steady progress. Balance on step-ups much improved. Confident in the gym now.
Shoulder feeling better. Added band pull-aparts as prehab. Good session.
Left shoulder flaring — avoided overhead movements. Using ice after sessions.
Settling into routine. Likes the seated row. Energy good today.
First session. Nervous but determined. Good baseline strength for her age. Hip ROM acceptable.

Hitting stride — weight jumps are consistent. Posture visibly better. Enjoys training.

form_notes: slight knee valgus on last rep

entries.observation_text: Weight is progressing well across all lifts. Squat depth consistent. Watch right knee tracking as load increases — history of ACL repair.
Best session yet. Moved to 12kg goblet squat. Core stable throughout. Great progress.
Recovery going well. Mentioned sleeping better. Ready to add a third exercise next session.
Progressed goblet squat to 10kg — handled it well. Confidence growing.
Energy better today. Core activation improving. No diastasis symptoms during dead bugs.
First session. Low energy, 4 hours sleep (baby waking). Kept intensity low. Good attitude.

plans.plan_text: Progress leg press by 2.5kg if last session was comfortable. Add band pull-aparts for shoulder health. Continue seated row at same weight, focus on form. Monitor left shoulder — impingement was flaring last week.

Long-term progression check. She's been training 12+ weeks now. Test leg press at 55kg for 3x10. Introduce bird dogs for core/balance. Right hip has been bothering her — modify step-ups to lower box height. Goal: maintain independence and bone density.
Baseline assessment and gentle introduction. Leg press (light), seated row, step-ups on low box. Focus on confidence and comfort in the gym. Watch hip ROM on step-ups given replacement history.

Lower body day. 4x8 barbell back squat — watch depth and knee tracking. 3x10 Romanian deadlift, focus on hinge pattern. 3x12 lunges each side. Core work: 3x plank to failure. If back feels tight from last session, swap RDLs for leg press.

Upper body focus. 4x8 bench press (start 40kg, add 2.5kg if last session was RPE <8). 3x10 lat pulldown. 3x10 overhead press with dumbbells. Emphasize form over load — he's progressing fast and needs good habits.

Focus on core reconnection and hip stability. 3x10 dead bugs (strict form), 3x8 goblet squats progressing from 8kg to 10kg if last session felt controlled. Add band walks if energy allows. Watch for diastasis symptoms — stop any exercise that causes doming.
